svg.title: OSCILLO-FIGHT HEXARENA
svg.desc: Tekken type 3D vector fighting game. Best of 3 rounds, six selectable fighters with unique special moves, SP meter, humanoid box fighters with per limb rays, hexagon floor, phosphor persistence via a rotating triple buffer. Full dual gamepad console flow: 0, 1 or 2 pads each get a matching character select and progression, LB/LT join 2P.

g.text: PAD : A KICK / B PUNCH / X DEF+BACK / Y JUMP-ATK / RT SP1 / LT SP2
PAD : DPAD+STICK MOVE / VIEW CAM / MENU START+PAUSE / LB-LT 2P JOIN
KEY P1 : WASD MOVE / J PUNCH / K KICK / L DEF / I+SPACE JUMP-ATK
KEY P1 : U SP1 / O SP2 / V VIEW / P PAUSE / ENTER START / T TOUCH
KEY P2 : ARROWS / N M , . / NPAD 1-6 (2P SHARED KEYBOARD)
MATCH : BEST OF 3 // 6 FIGHTERS // SPECIALS COST SP METER
XY RAW MAP // NO RE-CENTER // TRIPLE BUFFER // DUAL PAD BUILD 4
PAD : A KICK / B PUNCH / X DEF / Y JUMP-ATK / RT SP1 / LT SP2
PAD : MENU = START / VIEW = CAM / LB OR LT = 2 PLAYER VERSUS
KEYS : WASD MOVE / J K L I U O / V VIEW / P PAUSE / T TOUCH
ROSTER : VANGUARD-01 / GEAROX / VERMIL / KOLOSS / GHOST-9 / EMBERFANG
BEST OF 3 ROUNDS // SPECIALS COST SP METER
P1 : A/D CYCLE, J CONFIRM P2 : ARROWS CYCLE, N CONFIRM
